item.text:
**7B.6 Tinubu 2024 research note**
Verdict: **mixed, leaning negative**. There is some evidence of formal or reactive oversight, but the stronger record is hostile to independent scrutiny of conduct, corruption, and online reporting, and I found no public evidence that Tinubu voluntarily opened his own asset or campaign-finance records in 2024.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement | State House | 2024-06-15 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/ | Tinubu ordered the BPP reorganized for greater efficiency and transparency. This is a real anti-rent-seeking move and mild evidence that he sometimes tolerated corrective scrutiny inside procurement. | 7B.6; 7B.5 |
| Positive | President Tinubu: We’ll Unlock Trillions in Public Wealth to Boost Economy | Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation | 2024-02-20 | https://fmino.gov.ng/president-tinubu-well-unlock-trillions-in-public-wealth-to-boost-economy/ | Tinubu publicly framed state asset management as a way to boost public wealth and create jobs. This is not disclosure, but it is a pro-transparency, pro-audit policy posture. | 7B.6 |
| Positive / mixed | Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House says there were no internet connectivity shutdowns during the coverage period, which leaves some space for reporting and investigation. But the same report says legal pressure and intimidation still pushed journalists and activists to self-censor. | 7B.6 |
| Positive / reactive | Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors | TheCable | 2024-11-04 | https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/ | Tinubu ordered an investigation into the arrest and treatment of minors detained over the protests and said officers could face discipline. This is the strongest direct evidence that he sometimes allowed an inquiry after abuse became visible, but it was late and reactive. | 7B.6 |
| Negative | Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting | Committee to Protect Journalists | 2024-10-03 | https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/ | CPJ says four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act for corruption reporting despite the February reform. That is direct evidence that independent investigation of public-power abuse still triggered legal retaliation. | 7B.6 |
| Negative | Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown | Reuters via GPB | 2024-05-09 | https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown | Police detained Daniel Ojukwu under the cybercrime law after a corruption story. This is strong evidence that investigative reporting into official conduct remained punishable in practice. | 7B.6 |
| Negative | First Year Anniversary: SERAP Tells Tinubu To Publish Assets | Channels Television | 2024-05-26 | https://www.channelstv.com/2024/05/26/first-year-anniversary-serap-tells-tinubu-to-publish-assets/ | SERAP publicly urged Tinubu to publish his asset declaration and push an asset-publication database for top officials. The need for this demand is evidence that asset transparency remained insufficient and not voluntarily opened by the presidency. | 7B.6; 7B.4 |
| Negative | Nigeria charges protesters with treason and mutiny | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-09-02 | https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/ | Prosecutors escalated protest into treason and mutiny allegations, framing dissent as a security threat. That chilling climate undercuts any claim that the administration broadly tolerated independent scrutiny of official behavior. | 7B.6; 7B.5 |

**Search gap**
I did not find public 2024 evidence that Tinubu voluntarily published his own asset declaration, campaign-finance records, or a conflict-of-interest register. The record instead shows civil-society pressure for disclosure, continued cybercrime-based pressure on journalists, and only selective, reactive investigations when public outrage became unavoidable.
